projects.name: Legacy Rides
projects.description:
**Problem:** Drivers in East New York and Brooklyn need clear information about weekly car rentals for income-generating work.

**My contribution:** I work on the Legacy Rides website as a full-stack developer and GoHighLevel (GHL) integrator at BKMElevations LLC. Legacy Rides is one of the New York startup's clients. The project uses GoHighLevel alongside custom web development to present the rental service online.

**Result:** The client-facing website is available at [legacyrides.rentals](https://legacyrides.rentals/).

projects.name: eSihagBa
projects.description:
**Problem:** Barangay stakeholders need a way to track and verify how public funds are allocated.

**My contribution:** As lead full-stack developer for this capstone project, I built a budget transparency platform using TypeScript and Motoko on the Internet Computer Protocol (ICP), with an offline-first interface.

**Result:** The platform was piloted at Barangay Villa Verde, Iligan City. My [résumé](/Gumora-Resume.pdf) records five daily active users during the pilot; the [source code](https://github.com/Vantalim12/eSihagBaICBlockchain) is available on GitHub.

projects.name: iPlan (MSU-IIT System)
projects.description:
**Problem:** MSU-IIT offices need to submit and track budget and project proposals for university planning.

**My contribution:** During my internship with the Office of Planning and Development, I built the dashboard within the existing iPlan system using React, Vite, and Chart.js, focusing on proposal tracking and data visualization.

**Result:** The dashboard enabled offices to digitally submit and track their proposals. This internship contribution is documented in my [résumé](/Gumora-Resume.pdf).

projects.name: CCS Attendance Monitoring System
projects.description:
**Problem:** College events relied on manual attendance tracking across large student groups.

**My contribution:** As lead full-stack developer, I built and deployed a real-time attendance monitoring system using TypeScript and Node.js, with QR check-in and data management for event records.

**Result:** My [résumé](/Gumora-Resume.pdf) records adoption by CED (1,995 students) and CCS (1,200 students), replacing manual tracking for a combined 3,195 students. The [source code](https://github.com/Vantalim12/ccsattendancesystem) is available on GitHub.

projects.name: BetterIliganCity.org
projects.description:
**Problem:** Iligan residents need a central place to find government services, requirements, and procedures.

**My contribution:** I co-founded this volunteer-run civic tech project and work as a full-stack developer, building the portal with Next.js and Tailwind CSS through an open-source community contribution model.

**Result:** The portal is available at [betteriligancity.org](https://betteriligancity.org/), with [public source code](https://github.com/KishonShrill/BetterIligan) for community collaboration. Development is ongoing; my role is documented in my [résumé](/Gumora-Resume.pdf).
